T0089.title: Illicit Record Lookup
T0089.definition: An illicit service that reverse-lookups a target's complete personal dossier from a single clue such as a phone number.
T0089.description:
Illicit record lookup is a core underground data-trading service. Operators use social-engineering databases, insider access, exposed interfaces, or breached datasets to turn a phone number, name, or ID number into sensitive personal records such as identity details, addresses, bank cards, assets, travel, or hotel-stay information.

The service feeds targeted fraud, extortion, debt collection, and privacy abuse. Relevant controls focus on data-source tracing, abnormal query detection, insider misuse, and downstream trading channels.

T0089.usageExample: By providing just a phone number, underground groups can use a "Record Lookup" service to pull a target's household registration, marital status, and even hotel stay records, a deep privacy violation service typically charged per query.
